scope: Read-only PIE property/material wiring queries, installed asset and code inspection, own setup script review. No water or vegetation changes applied; no new runtime behavior test.

ocean_material.exclusion_wiring_confirmed: ShaderWorldWaterExclusion_0 Opacity Mask output -> Multiply_0 input B -> MakeMaterialAttributes_0 OpacityMask -> material attributes output

installed_asset_findings.ocean_map_biome: Black Alder trees, ordinary grass and rocks; land-oriented variants, not a marine flora collection.
installed_asset_findings.marine_plant_asset_search: No matching marine flora assets found among the installed asset names or the five biome assets. This does not limit custom spawnables.

code_findings.shore_attenuation: Terrain heights affect spectrum displacement through Ocean DataSource. Attenuation 1 removes local waves on land; 0.95 retains 5 percent. Uncovered terrain cache is treated as deep water.
code_findings.wave_failure_diagnosis: Correct actor references do not prove valid GPU cache coverage. Five percent residual waves alone do not establish the cause of waves crossing a 3 m plateau.
code_findings.water_exclusion: Native Air Pocket Box, Capsule and Spline Tube affect water queries. Visual removal requires a masked water material with Water Exclusion connected; the current material wiring was confirmed, but no volume behavior was tested.
code_findings.cpu_water_sampling: The inspected CPU ocean provider documents deep-water evaluation without coastal attenuation; gameplay and rendered shoreline need separate tests.
code_findings.vegetation: Spawnable altitude intervals are evaluated against ground height. The old negative minima permit vegetation at the new -1800 cm seabed. Water height is not automatically substituted for these ranges.

road_composition.dirt_approaches: Native ShaderWorld SWSplineRoadComponent; terrain shaping and AltitudeBasedLayer material/biome writes.

road_composition.yellow_center_lines: Own narrow Engine Cube meshes with a yellow material.
